title: 🏆 Capstone · Rust Playground Offline
summary: Compose all three tracks into one product: an offline developer-learning environment — lesson system, editor, compiler integration, test runner, diagnostics, progress, notes and persistence. This very application is your reference architecture.
requirements: Lesson system rendering markdown from an embedded content tree (include_dir)
Monaco editor wired to sandboxed rustc compile+run with 5s timeout and cancellation registry
Structured compiler diagnostics rendered as teachable cards
cargo test runner scoped to validated workspace paths (--offline)
Progress tracking with declarative prerequisite unlocks persisted in migrated SQLite
Zero network calls at runtime — CSP self-origin only
Automated tests: engine unlock matrix, migrations idempotency, IPC validation, store behavior

milestones.detail: Embedded catalog + validation errors at startup.

starterFiles.name: ARCHITECTURE-CHECKLIST.md
starterFiles.code:
# Build order (each gate must be green before next)
1. contracts/domain.ts == serde DTOs
2. content loader validates embedded tree
3. engine pure fns tested
4. db migrations idempotent
5. execution sandbox: validator tests red→green
6. stores over mocked ipc
7. views compose stores
8. verify script: typecheck + vitest + cargo test

hints: Steal shamelessly from this repo's structure — that's the point.
Keep commands thin FIRST; retrofitting thinness hurts.
Ship the security doc with known limitations — honesty scales.
completionCriteria: npm run verify passes end-to-end locally
App runs fully offline after install (airplane test)
All DoD bullets demonstrable in one sitting
